author: GamingBolt
description:
Even with its highs and lows, Hell Let Loose: Vietnam has some appeal, even if it's far from the most mainstream. I wouldn't recommend abandoning your PvP comfort pick any time soon, but you never know - Vietnam may become an appealing destination in the next six months. 

For now, it's a question of whether Expression Games can capitalize and refine it into something truly special.
title: Hell Let Loose: Vietnam Review - Brimming With Potential, But It Needed More Time in the Oven

author: GamingBolt
description:
Insomniac’s next great superhero power fantasy is nearly upon us, but instead of swinging gracefully between skyscrapers we’re lacerating faces, taking bullets, and waiting to heal. From stalking enemies through the shadows to ripping them open with adamantium claws, Marvel’s Wolverine promises an action game unlike anything the Spider-Man studio has attempted before. 

The trailers already show that Logan isn’t pulling his punches. The game, clearly, leans into his ferocity, but there’s more at play than simply making a bloody mess. Here’s ten things I can’t wait to do in Marvel’s Wolverine.
title: Marvel’s Wolverine - 10 Things I CAN'T WAIT To Try Out

author: GamingBolt
description:
In case you didn't notice, Phantom Blade Zero recently debuted on the Steam Top 100 Sellers chart...and is now the number one best-selling game. That's after reports that it was the most wishlisted game on the platform for the year, beating The Blood of Dawnwalker, Onimusha: Way of the Sword, Control Resonant, and so many other titles.

Obviously, pre-orders going live is one thing - further reassurance that S-Game's martial arts odyssey is well and truly set for release in October. But could something else have happened that spurred fans to buy it ASAP?
title: Phantom Blade Zero NEW Gameplay Just Put Every Other 2026 Game On Notice
